description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developments - Amendment to the Gaz. Extra Ordinary No. 2129/96  of the 28.06.2019, published on  Mahawa Urban Development Area
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter involving the rectification of a previous gazette notification concerning urban development planning. It references specific sections of the Urban Development Authority Law (No. 41 of 1978) and its amendments, making it primarily about legal procedures and regulatory corrections rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring. The content focuses on technical corrections to legal documentation and statutory procedures.
